name: Candy Cartel 0.5g Live Rosin Disposable
description: Breeder: Beanfiendz Terpenes: Limonene, ß-Caryophyllene, ß-Myrcene Aroma: Vanilla Cream, Candied Citrus, Buttery Biscotti Effects: Calm, Happy, Relaxed Step into the world of Candy Cartel, where indulgence meets tranquility. A cross between Biscotti and Sherb Cream Pie, this hybrid offers an irresistible blend of rich, creamy sweetness and a touch of citrus zest. The dense, frosty buds glisten with trichomes, and the aroma fills the air like fresh-baked desserts with a citrusy twist. As the effects take hold, you’ll feel a wave of calm wash over you, paired with a burst of happiness and relaxation. Perfect for those seeking a smooth escape, Candy Cartel delivers a serene high that lets you unwind in style.
